claim: Sample data can be reset and stays separate from a new plan
sandbox: enter from the one-click /?demo=1 link; reset one demo-only meal, add another, start for real, return to /demo, and assert both probes are absent while the shipped sample remains

claim: The demo includes six sample meals
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; count six distinct sample meal ids and assert the demo banner is visible

claim: Exports the visible meal plan as JSON
sandbox: demo data; download and parse the JSON, then assert all six sample meals

claim: Imports complete Family Meal Lanes JSON without replacing the current plan when a file is incomplete
sandbox: demo data; import a complete JSON plan, then an incomplete file and assert the recovery message, imported meal, and no page error

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo, wait for the service worker, reload, set offline, and reload

claim: Meal plan saved only on this device
sandbox: record all requests during a demo meal save and assert only the app origin is used

claim: Shows a shared meal in every selected lane
sandbox: demo data; assert Lemon chicken tray bake appears in Shared, Mara, Jon, and Kids lanes

claim: Shows prep labels on meal slips
sandbox: demo data; assert the sample meal's prep label is visible
demo data; click Print and assert the browser print method is called

claim: Export, import, and print are available without a license
sandbox: fresh real plan without a license; save and export a meal, import a complete plan, then invoke print

claim: Saves named lanes for shared meals
sandbox: fresh real plan; add Ari, save, reload, and assert Ari is available as a meal lane and sharing checkbox
fresh real plan; assert the visible price, Sociobot checkout URL, and live Dodo hosted-checkout redirect

claim: Free plans include Shared plus three people
sandbox: fresh real plan; add three people, attempt a fourth, and assert the visible limit explanation while the dialog remains open

claim: A valid $12 license adds unlimited lanes on this device
sandbox: fresh real plan; mock a valid Sociobot response, restore a token, and add a fifth lane

claim: An inactive license relocks unlimited lanes and is checked no more than once a day
sandbox: mock an inactive Sociobot response, reload, assert the visible inactive notice and free limit, and assert one verification request

claim: License checks send only the license token to Sociobot, never meal-plan data
sandbox: save a real meal, mock verification, and assert one GET to Sociobot with a license query and no request body or meal text
